name: hal_paper
description: Board support for the M5 Paper (v1.0 and v1.1): ESP32-D0WDQ6-V3, 16 MB of flash, 8 MB of PSRAM, the main power hold on GPIO2 and a dial of three keys. What is the chip's, including the reader of those keys and the radio, is in hal_esp32. The e-ink panel, the touch, the RTC chip, the gauge are not here yet (docs/50, docs/90).
